primer: ZF Steering Gear (India) Ltd holds a 90% domestic commercial-vehicle steering duopoly and scales aluminium extrusions via DriveSys Systems. Heavy capex kept trailing ROCE at 6.48% and free cash flow negative for three straight years, while ₹47 Cr depreciation caps FY28E core PAT near ₹28 Cr. At ₹778.90, our ₹795 base target offers only 0.67:1 support-zone asymmetry, so we assign REJECTED on valuation and cash flow with zero shares held. We would revisit only if DriveSys turns free cash flow solidly positive and core net profit exceeds ₹40 Cr.
